newsitem.title: UK: Russia Med fuel oil exports fall in Aug - Petrak.
newsitem.headline: Russia Med fuel oil exports fall in Aug - Petrak.

text.p: Fuel oil exports from the Russian Black Sea ports of Novorossiisk and Tuapse and the Ukrainian port of Odessa were 425,000 tonnes in August, some 90,000 tonnes less than in July, shipping inspectors Petrak said.
These are the main Russian fuel oil export routes into the Mediterranean, though product is also exported from Batumi.

Traders and analysts had earlier estimated total Black Sea fuel oil exports at around half a million tonnes in August, and calculated total exports to western Europe out of the Baltics and the Black Sea at 1.7 to 1.9 million tonnes.
The Petrak monthly report showed that fuel oil exports out of the Baltic port of Ventspils were around 80,000 tonnes in August, down from about 105,000 in July.
Data for the other main Baltic fuel oil export ports -- St Petersburg, Tallinn and Klaipeda -- were not provided.
